title: A Facile and Reproducible Synthesis of Near-Infrared Fluorescent Conjugates with Small Targeting Molecules for Microbial Infection Imaging
molecular_or_platform_basis: Vanco-800CW: vancomycin conjugated with IRDye800CW-NHS; optimized small-molecule conjugation workflow
evidence_use: Published synthetic starting point and in-vitro Gram-positive targeting evidence
translation_boundary: No jaw, bone, in-vivo dosing, toxicology, or clinical administration evidence for this project

title: Bacteria-targeted fluorescence imaging of extracted osteosynthesis devices for rapid visualization of fracture-related infections
molecular_or_platform_basis: Vanco-800CW; 760 nm excitation and 797-841 nm detection band reported on an intraoperative camera
evidence_use: 13 patient extracted devices; Gram-positive biofilm signal correlated with culture and result available in less than 30 minutes
translation_boundary: Ex-vivo orthopedic device study; cannot establish jaw tissue performance or patient safety

title: P800SO3-PEG: a renal clearable bone-targeted fluorophore for theranostic imaging
molecular_or_platform_basis: Sulfonated sulfur-substituted heptamethine cyanine with PEG linker; 760 nm NIR-I and 808 nm NIR-II experimental excitation
evidence_use: Hydroxyapatite/calcium-phosphate affinity, signal-background ratio above 3.5, renal clearance, and animal bone retention
translation_boundary: No bacterial or necrotic-bone selectivity; NIR-II hardware support remains unverified

title: Quasi-dendritic sulfonate-based organic small molecule for high-quality NIR-II bone-targeted imaging
evidence_use: Hydroxyapatite affinity, macrophage accumulation, bone uptake, and osteoporosis-mouse NIR-II imaging
translation_boundary: No jaw osteomyelitis, bacterial selectivity, device measurement, or clinical evidence

title: Azide-Dye Unexpected Bone Targeting for Near-Infrared Window II Osteoporosis Imaging
evidence_use: In-vitro hydroxyapatite accumulation 5-fold and macrophage uptake 5.6-fold over non-azide comparator; osteoporosis-mouse imaging
translation_boundary: Single-function bone-affinity evidence only; full text accessibility and device fit require separate confirmation

title: Fluorescent risedronate analogue 800CW-pRIS improves tooth extraction-associated abnormal wound healing in zoledronate-treated mice
evidence_use: Hydroxyapatite affinity and a mouse jaw extraction/osteonecrosis model provide jaw-adjacent material evidence
translation_boundary: Designed for bisphosphonate displacement and wound-healing research; lacks infection selectivity

title: Two new, near-infrared, fluorescent probes as potential tools for imaging bone repair
evidence_use: alpha5beta1L-CyTE777 reported at 777 nm excitation and 820 nm emission; pamidronate supports hydroxyapatite targeting
translation_boundary: Bone-repair model; no infection or jaw osteomyelitis validation

title: Lanthanide/Cu2-xSe Nanoparticles for Bacteria-Activated NIR-II Fluorescence Imaging of Infection
molecular_or_platform_basis: Vancomycin-modified lanthanide nanoparticle coupled with Cu2-xSe quenching system
evidence_use: Gram-positive bacteria activated the NIR-II signal in animal infection studies
translation_boundary: Nanoparticle pharmacology, Gram-negative coverage, jaw specificity, and NIR-II device fit remain unverified

title: Vancomycin-based tracers guiding in situ visualization of bacteria on osteosynthesis devices and surgical debridement
molecular_or_platform_basis: Vancomycin-IRDye800CW paired with a vancomycin PET tracer
evidence_use: Post-mortem human tibia/femur model; fluorescence visualized and guided removal of Gram-positive biofilm
translation_boundary: Post-mortem implant model; no living jaw, necrotic-bone, pharmacokinetic, or patient-use evidence
